ev.q: All 17 exposed workers completed the questionnaire.
Thirteen (77%) reported high-risk activities, including four (24%)
Five persons (29%) reported an underlying condition
None of the exposed laboratory workers had symptoms consistent with melioidosis
Two laboratory workers had titers of < 20 for B. pseudomallei
An onsite investigation was conducted on August 7.
This report summarizes the results of that investigation

methods_quotes.q: Laboratory procedures were reviewed and work activities classified into high and low risk.
Active surveillance was conducted for symptoms consistent with melioidosis among exposed workers.
with a positive result defined as a titer > 40
